segments.name: retail center properties
segments.description: Owns and leases income-producing retail center properties to tenants, earning rental income from them.
segments.evidence: The Ashley Plaza Property consists of a single-story, main retail strip building constructed in 1977.

segments.name: flex center properties
segments.description: Owns and leases income-producing flex-industrial properties to tenants, earning rental income from them.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had three reportable segments, consisting of retail center properties, flex center properties and STNL properties.

segments.name: STNL properties
segments.description: Owns single tenant net lease properties, each occupied by one tenant, treated as a separate asset class.
segments.evidence: STNL properties are also considered by the real estate industry as a separate asset class.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rental income and reimbursements for leasing the company's real estate properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Operating revenues include rental income, tenant reimbursements, and other property income; and operating expenses include retail center property, flex center property and single tenant net lease property operating costs.
